int.name: AuthChallengeDecode
int.label: Local protobuf or validation failure while decoding bam_api.AuthChallengeResponse

int.name: ConfigDecode
int.label: Local protobuf decode failure while decoding bam_api.ConfigResponse

int.name: SchedulerEnvelopeDecode
int.label: Local protobuf or scheduler-envelope decode failure while decoding bam_api.SchedulerResponse

int.name: RequestFailed
int.label: HTTP or gRPC request completed with a non-OK status

int.name: Resolve
int.label: DNS resolution failure while resolving the BAM endpoint

int.name: Connect
int.label: TCP connect failure while establishing the BAM transport

int.name: Io
int.label: TLS, HTTP/2, or stream I/O failure on an established BAM connection

int.name: UnsupportedVersion
int.label: Unsupported scheduler-response version received from the BAM peer

int.name: RequestTimeout
int.label: Auth, config, or scheduler-stream gRPC request timed out

int.name: KeepaliveTimeout
int.label: HTTP/2 keepalive PING timed out

int.name: BuilderActivityTimeout
int.label: Scheduler-stream BuilderHeartBeat watchdog timed out while the scheduler stream was live

int.name: ConnectTimeout
int.label: TCP, TLS, or HTTP/2 handshake did not complete within 5 seconds of dialing

int.name: InvalidBatch
int.label: Batch rejected because AtomicTxnBatch decode or structural validation failed

int.name: EmptyBatch
int.label: Batch rejected because it contained zero packets

int.name: VoteTxn
int.label: Batch rejected because it contained a simple vote transaction

int.name: EmptyMessage
int.label: multiple_atomic_txn_batch wrapper rejected because it contained zero AtomicTxnBatch entries

int.name: OverflowMessage
int.label: multiple_atomic_txn_batch wrapper rejected because it exceeded the local max batch count

int.name: LeaderStateEnqueued
int.label: Leader-state message accepted by gRPC stream_send

int.name: LeaderStateEnqueueFailed
int.label: Leader-state send attempted but fd_grpc_client_stream_send returned failure

int.name: ResultEnqueued
int.label: Result message accepted by gRPC stream_send

int.name: ResultEnqueueFailed
int.label: Result send attempted but fd_grpc_client_stream_send returned failure

int.name: HeartbeatEnqueued
int.label: Validator heartbeat message accepted by gRPC stream_send

int.name: HeartbeatEnqueueFailed
int.label: Validator heartbeat send attempted on a live scheduler stream but fd_grpc_client_stream_send returned failure

int.name: DownToLive
int.label: Scheduler stream accepted: the BAM node sent its first BuilderHeartBeat

int.name: LiveToDown
int.label: Accepted scheduler stream ended

int.name: ClientReset
int.label: Pending leader-state cleared because BAM client was reset

int.name: RequestFailed
int.label: Pending leader-state cleared because scheduler stream request failed

int.name: StreamEnded
int.label: Pending leader-state cleared because scheduler stream ended

int.name: StreamTimeout
int.label: Pending leader-state cleared because scheduler stream timed out

int.name: NotLeader
int.label: Leader-state send suppressed because pack reported no active leader slot

int.name: Expired
int.label: Leader-state send suppressed because slot_end_ns was known and already elapsed

int.name: SchedulerRejected
int.label: Retained leader state cleared because the scheduler rejected it as outside the valid slot range

int.name: FreshWork
int.label: Healthy BAM-owned leader slot ended after fresh current-slot BAM work arrived before slot end

int.name: None
int.label: Healthy BAM-owned leader slot ended without fresh current-slot BAM work arriving before slot end

int.name: NoIngress
int.label: No BAM ingress was observed for the slot before its local retention window expired

int.name: FirstBeforeEnd
int.label: The first BAM ingress observed for the slot arrived before slot end

int.name: FirstAfterEnd
int.label: The first BAM ingress observed for the slot arrived after slot end

int.name: UnknownSlotEnd
int.label: BAM ingress was observed for the slot but slot_end_ns was unavailable when the slot aged out of the retention window

int.name: BeforeEnd
int.label: BAM ingress transactions observed before slot end

int.name: AfterEnd
int.label: BAM ingress transactions observed after slot end

int.name: UnknownSlotEnd
int.label: BAM ingress transactions observed while slot_end_ns was unavailable

int.name: NoIngress
int.label: No scheduler-receive callback yet

int.name: SlotEndUnknown
int.label: First callback seen, slot end not known yet

int.name: BeforeEnd
int.label: First callback before slot end

int.name: AfterEnd
int.label: First callback at or after slot end

int.name: Enqueued
int.label: Pong message was accepted by fd_grpc_client_stream_send on a live scheduler stream

int.name: FrameTxBusy
int.label: Scheduler Ping arrived on a live stream but the local HTTP/2 TX frame buffer was not empty, so Pong was skipped

int.name: RequestBusy
int.label: Scheduler Ping arrived on a live stream but a gRPC request body was still sending, so Pong was skipped

int.name: SendFailed
int.label: Pong send was attempted on a live scheduler stream after local readiness checks but fd_grpc_client_stream_send returned failure

bool.name: IsEnabled
bool.summary: Whether the operator has enabled BAM

bool.name: IsHealthy
bool.summary: Whether the BAM client transport, auth, config, scheduler stream, and builder heartbeat recency checks all pass; does not imply that fresh work for the current leader slot has arrived

bool.name: IsStreamLive
bool.summary: Whether the BAM scheduler gRPC stream is open, from its response headers on; the BAM node may still reject an open stream, StreamTransitioned counts accepted streams

gauge.name: LeaderStateSlot
gauge.summary: Validator leader slot in the latest pack leader-state snapshot, 0 if none has been observed yet

gauge.name: LeaderStateTick
gauge.summary: Tick within the leader slot in the latest pack leader-state snapshot, 0 if none

time.name: LeaderStateSlotEndTime
time.summary: Wall-clock end of the leader slot in the latest pack leader-state snapshot, 0 if unknown

counter.name: TxnPublished
counter.summary: Transactions published to verify, including transactions unpacked from bundles

counter.name: AtomicBatchPublished
counter.summary: Revert-on-error atomic transaction batches published to verify as atomic BAM batches

counter.name: FeedbackResultDropped
counter.summary: Feedback results dropped because the local result queue was full, a result link was overrun, the validator identity or BAM endpoint changed, BAM was disabled, or the BAM node repeated a scheduler stream rejection while no leader slot in the current epoch was known

counter.name: IngressPktOversizeRejected
counter.summary: BAM packets rejected because their protobuf data payload exceeded the local transaction MTU

counter.name: BuilderHeartbeatDecoded
counter.summary: Builder heartbeat messages decoded from the BAM node

counter.name: ClientFailed
counter.summary: BAM control-plane or session failures, by cause; scheduler payload and atomic batch rejects are counted in IngressBatchRejected

gauge.name: HeapCapacityBytes
gauge.summary: Workspace capacity reserved for the BAM tile; sampled at most once per second to avoid repeated workspace scans

gauge.name: HeapFreeBytes
gauge.summary: Estimated free capacity in the BAM tile workspace heap; sampled at most once per second to avoid repeated workspace scans

counter.name: KeepaliveAcked
counter.summary: HTTP/2 keepalive PING acknowledgments received from the BAM node

counter.name: HealthyConnected
counter.summary: Transitions into the BAM CONNECTED_HEALTHY state

counter.name: HealthyDisconnected
counter.summary: Transitions out of the BAM CONNECTED_HEALTHY state

counter.name: GrpcStreamChunkTx
counter.summary: Unary gRPC request bodies (auth challenge and config) fully written to the HTTP/2 send buffer with END_STREAM; scheduler-stream messages are not counted

counter.name: GrpcStreamChunkTxBytes
counter.summary: Outbound HTTP/2 bytes of all frame types, before TLS encryption, handed by the BAM gRPC client to the transport

counter.name: GrpcStreamChunkRx
counter.summary: Inbound gRPC message segments processed from HTTP/2 DATA payloads; one DATA frame can yield several segments when it carries several messages or arrives in pieces

counter.name: GrpcStreamChunkRxBytes
counter.summary: Inbound HTTP/2 bytes of all frame types, after TLS decryption, received by the BAM gRPC client from the transport

counter.name: GrpcRequestSent
counter.summary: gRPC requests started (auth challenge, config, and scheduler-stream calls), counted when the request is queued, whether or not its body has finished sending

gauge.name: GrpcStreamOpen
gauge.summary: HTTP/2 streams opened by the BAM gRPC client that are not closed, as counted against the BAM node's concurrent-stream limit

counter.name: IngressMultiMessageReceived
counter.summary: multiple_atomic_txn_batch messages decoded from BAM ingress

counter.name: IngressBatchCommitAttempted
counter.summary: Atomic transaction batches that entered BAM validate and commit

counter.name: IngressBatchPublished
counter.summary: Atomic transaction batches published to verify

counter.name: TxnBackpressureRejected
counter.summary: BAM scheduler transactions rejected because the pending transaction queue lacked capacity

counter.name: IngressBatchRejected
counter.summary: Atomic transaction batches rejected after decode and batch-level validation, by reason; wrapper-level message rejects are counted in IngressMessageRejected

counter.name: IngressMessageRejected
counter.summary: multiple_atomic_txn_batch wrapper messages rejected, by reason; these count scheduler messages, not atomic batches

counter.name: OutboundEnqueueAttempted
counter.summary: Leader-state, result, and heartbeat fd_grpc_client_stream_send calls on a live scheduler stream, by result; sends deferred because the stream is not live or the gRPC client cannot accept another message yet are not counted

counter.name: StreamTransitioned
counter.summary: Scheduler stream acceptance transitions, by type; a stream counts as accepted from the BAM node's first builder heartbeat, and one the node rejects after its response headers is counted in ClientFailed instead

counter.name: LeaderPendingDropped
counter.summary: Pending leader-state updates cleared before send because the BAM client reset, the scheduler request failed, or the stream ended or timed out, by reason

counter.name: LeaderStateSuppressed
counter.summary: Pack-provided BAM leader-state updates suppressed or cleared because the state was not locally live, by reason

counter.name: LeaderPendingReplaced
counter.summary: Pending leader-state updates replaced by a newer leader-state update before send

counter.name: SlotIngressRetired
counter.summary: BAM slot-ingress records retired after they aged out of the local retention window, by when the first scheduler-receive callback for that slot arrived relative to slot end, unknown when slot_end_ns was unavailable

counter.name: SlotIngressTxnRx
counter.summary: BAM ingress transactions counted in retired slot-ingress records using scheduler-receive callback timestamps, by timing class: before or after slot end only when slot_end_ns was known at observation time, else unknown

counter.name: HealthyLeaderSlotEnded
counter.summary: Local leader slots that reached slot_end_ns while BAM status was CONNECTED_HEALTHY, by whether fresh current-slot BAM work had arrived before slot end

counter.name: SchedulerPongSendAttempted
counter.summary: Scheduler Ping-to-Pong sends on a live scheduler stream, by result, including local send-boundary contention and fd_grpc_client_stream_send failures

gauge.name: LastKeepaliveRttNanos
gauge.summary: Last HTTP/2 keepalive round-trip sample, 0 if none since the client last reset

gauge.name: KeepaliveRttSmoothedNanos
gauge.summary: Exponentially smoothed HTTP/2 keepalive round-trip estimate, 0 if none since the client last reset

gauge.name: KeepaliveRttDeviationNanos
gauge.summary: Smoothed HTTP/2 keepalive round-trip variation estimate, 0 if none since the client last reset

bool.name: IsKeepaliveRttValid
bool.summary: Whether an HTTP/2 keepalive round-trip sample has been observed since the client last reset, so the keepalive round-trip gauges hold estimates

gauge.name: FeedbackResultPending
gauge.summary: BAM feedback results buffered for send

gauge.name: TxnPending
gauge.summary: Validated BAM scheduler transactions buffered and waiting for bam_verif credits

gauge.name: LeaderSlotFirstIngressState
gauge.summary: When the first scheduler-receive callback for the current leader slot arrived relative to slot end

histogram.name: BuilderHeartbeatArrivalDelayNanos
histogram.summary: Local scheduler-stream receive callback time minus the remote builder heartbeat timestamp; includes clock offset and is intended only for relative trend analysis

histogram.name: SchedulerPongSendDurationNanos
histogram.summary: Local BAM scheduler Ping-to-Pong send-boundary turnaround, from the scheduler-message receive callback to local readiness classification or the fd_grpc_client_stream_send outcome on a live scheduler stream; local processing and send-boundary latency, not network round trip

int.name: NewSeqBeforeComplete
int.label: Active BAM bundle abandoned because a new sequence arrived before completion

int.name: LeaderSlotEnd
int.label: Active BAM bundle abandoned at leader slot end

int.name: PohTimeout
int.label: Active BAM bundle abandoned because the leader-slot wallclock deadline elapsed

int.name: SingleOutsideSlot
int.label: Independent BAM transaction invalidated because packing moved outside its allowed slot window

int.name: BundleOutsideSlot
int.label: Fully assembled BAM bundle invalidated because packing moved outside its allowed slot window

int.name: Received
int.label: BAM work reached pack after ingress preprocessing and resolution

int.name: Accepted
int.label: BAM work was accepted into pack's main transaction pool

int.name: RejectedPrePending
int.label: BAM work was rejected before entering pack's pending-work tracker

int.name: PendingEntered
int.label: BAM work entered pack's pending-work tracker after acceptance

int.name: PendingEvicted
int.label: BAM work was evicted from pack's pending-work tracker by later slot or blockhash revalidation

int.name: Scheduled
int.label: BAM work was removed from the pending-work tracker and scheduled into a microblock

int.name: Landed
int.label: BAM work was observed as landed via execution feedback

int.name: CompletedUnlanded
int.label: BAM work completed execution but at least one transaction did not land

int.name: RejectedPrePending
int.label: BAM work was first rejected before entering pack's pending-work tracker

int.name: TrackingRejected
int.label: BAM work was accepted into pack but rejected because the tracked-work table was full

int.name: PendingEvicted
int.label: BAM work entered pack's pending-work tracker and was later evicted by slot or blockhash revalidation

int.name: Scheduled
int.label: BAM work entered pack's pending-work tracker and was later first scheduled into a microblock

int.name: BundleAssemblyAbandoned
int.label: Multi-transaction BAM work was abandoned before full assembly completed

int.name: NoEvent
int.label: No BAM event of this kind was observed before the leader slot finished

int.name: BeforeEnd
int.label: The first BAM event of this kind was observed before slot end

int.name: AfterEnd
int.label: The first BAM event of this kind was observed at or after slot end

counter.name: BamBundleAssemblyAbandoned
counter.summary: In-progress multi-transaction BAM bundles abandoned before full assembly, by reason

counter.name: BamWorkPrePendingRejected
counter.summary: BAM transactions or fully assembled BAM bundles rejected by slot or blockhash revalidation before they were accepted into pack's pending-work tracker, by work kind and reason

counter.name: BamPendingWorkEvicted
counter.summary: BAM pending-work items evicted after acceptance into pack because slot or blockhash revalidation later failed, by work kind and reason

counter.name: BamWorkObserved
counter.summary: BAM work items observed at each pack lifecycle state, by state; a multi-transaction BAM bundle counts as one item

counter.name: BamTrackingRejected
counter.summary: BAM work items rejected because the local tracked-work table was at capacity

counter.name: BamTrackingTxnRejected
counter.summary: BAM transactions rejected because the local tracked-work table was at capacity

gauge.name: BamPendingWorkCount
gauge.summary: BAM work items tracked in pack's pending-work set after acceptance and before scheduling or cleanup

gauge.name: LeaderSlot
gauge.summary: Slot at which we are currently leader, or 0 if none

time.name: LeaderSlotEndTime
time.summary: Wall-clock end of the current pack leader slot, 0 if pack is not the leader

counter.name: BamLeaderSlotEndedByInsert
counter.summary: Pack leader slots ended, by whether the first BAM insert came before slot end, at or after slot end, or not at all

counter.name: BamLeaderSlotEndedBySchedule
counter.summary: Pack leader slots ended, by whether the first BAM schedule came before slot end, at or after slot end, or not at all

counter.name: BamWorkProcessed
counter.summary: BAM work items that reached a first terminal pack outcome, by that outcome

histogram.name: BamWorkRxToFirstOutcomeNanos
histogram.summary: BAM scheduler receive to first terminal pack outcome of a BAM work item, sampled once when that work is first rejected, tracking-rejected, pending-evicted, scheduled, or bundle-assembly-abandoned

counter.name: BamConflictBlocked
counter.summary: Scheduling attempts blocked by account conflicts on the selected BAM candidate; does not establish that a later independent batch was runnable or measure lost earnings

counter.name: BamWorkSlotEndUnscheduled
counter.summary: Tracked BAM batches still pending when a leader slot closes, retired as OUTSIDE_LEADER_SLOT; excludes dispatched batches and does not establish validity, schedulability, or lost earnings

counter.name: BamCapacityDeferred
counter.summary: BAM candidate groups newly deferred for the current block after exhausting the capacity-miss budget; counts each candidate group's first deferral

counter.name: BamLookaheadMiss
counter.summary: Bounded conflict lookahead scans, run after the selected BAM candidate was blocked by account conflicts, that found no independent ready batch

gauge.name: SlotDurationNanos
gauge.summary: Slot duration replay currently assumes, 0 without BAM
